pages.text: Sarcophagite, grey: 14 blocks, 3 fragments. Sarcophagite, pale: 2 blocks (reserved, Researcher's Order). Grey limestone, quarried: 840 blocks. Grey limestone, reclaimed: 112 blocks. Bell alloy, ingots: 23. Bell alloy, poured blanks: 6. Note: sarcophagite supply continues to decline. No new deposits identified in current survey season. Guild recommends substitution with standard grey limestone where structural use permits. Researcher's Order has objected to substitution for their purposes.
